What is BSc Anesthesia and Operation Theatre Technology?

content.text: The three-year undergraduate program, BSc in Anesthesia and OT Technology, is aimed at training students in managing an anesthesia procedure and assisting during surgeries. In the OT and anesthesia course details, subjects are anatomy, physiology, pharmacology, anesthesia technology, surgical equipment handling & patient monitoring techniques. The education will incorporate classroom teaching blended with real clinical training in the OT.

Anaesthesia technologists prepare anesthesia apparatus, help the anesthesiologist administer the anesthesias and monitor patients during (and after) a surgical procedure. OT technicians make the operation theatre sterile, arrange the surgical instruments and support the surgeons during surgery. They both constitute an essential element of the surgical team aiming at patient protection and correct execution of interventions.
